cohort: 1,268 women who had an intrauterine pressure catheter placement during labor at a tertiary referral hospital from January 2016 to June 2018
finding: This study found that amnioinfusion during labor, when compared to intrauterine pressure catheter alone, did not significantly increase the odds of intraamniotic infection or other adverse outcomes such as postpartum endometritis, hemorrhage, or cesarean delivery.
